user.title: Add discrete statistics
user.description: Records how long this entity spends in each state, and how often it changes, as long-term statistics kept independently of the recorder's purge window.

data_description.entity_id: The binary or enum entity to track. It cannot be changed later, because it determines the statistic IDs.

data_description.name: Shown on charts. Leave blank to follow the entity’s own name.
data_description.default: Time in an ignored state is credited to the previous recorded state - it never creates a gap, and it does not count as a transition.
data_description.min_duration: Used only by the choices that mention it, and one minute if left blank. A state the entity leaves again sooner than this is not recorded: the previous state carries on as though it had never been left, and no transition is counted. At most one hour.

states.name: States
states.description: How each state is recorded, overriding the choice above. Pick another state to record it as that state instead - two states the entity reports for the same thing become one - or type a name the entity has never reported. A state that appears later follows the choice above.

data_description.blank: Some entities report a state with no letters or digits at all - empty, or punctuation. That has no name to record under, so this says what becomes of it. Type any state name to record it as that instead.

abort.already_configured: This entity already has discrete statistics.
abort.yaml_configured: This entity is configured in configuration.yaml. Edit it there, or remove it from YAML first.

error.blank_record: A blank state has no name to record it under. Choose Ignore, or type a state name to record it as.
error.blank_unusable: That has no letters or digits either, so it cannot name a statistic. Choose Ignore, or type a state name.
error.continuous_state: That entity reports a continuous measurement. Discrete Statistics tracks entities with a fixed set of states, such as on/off or a list of modes.
error.target_unusable: A state name typed here needs letters or digits, so it can name a statistic.

data_description.name: Shown on charts. Leave blank to follow the entity’s own name.
data_description.default: Time in an ignored state is credited to the previous recorded state - it never creates a gap, and it does not count as a transition. Changing this recompiles the entity's whole history.
data_description.min_duration: Used only by the choices that mention it, and one minute if left blank. A state the entity leaves again sooner than this is not recorded: the previous state carries on as though it had never been left, and no transition is counted. At most one hour.

states.name: States
states.description: How each state is recorded, overriding the choice above. Pick another state to record it as that state instead - two states the entity reports for the same thing become one - or type a name the entity has never reported. A state that appears later follows the choice above.

data_description.blank: Some entities report a state with no letters or digits at all - empty, or punctuation. That has no name to record under, so this says what becomes of it. Type any state name to record it as that instead.

error.blank_record: A blank state has no name to record it under. Choose Ignore, or type a state name to record it as.
error.blank_unusable: That has no letters or digits either, so it cannot name a statistic. Choose Ignore, or type a state name.
error.target_unusable: A state name typed here needs letters or digits, so it can name a statistic.

user.title: Add a period sensor
user.description: A number calculated from the statistics recorded for **{entity}**: how long it spent in a state, what share of the period that was, or how often it changed.

data_description.states: Pick one or more states to combine, or type in a custom state. Leave empty to count changes between every state.
data_description.metric: Time is in hours. Share is the time as a percentage of the period so far.
data_description.period: Periods start at midnight, on Monday, on the first of the month or the first of January, in this Home Assistant's time zone.
data_description.name: Leave blank for a name made from the entity, the states and the period.
data_description.live: Statistics are compiled hourly. With this on, the sensor follows the entity's changes since the last compiled hour as they happen; with it off, it updates once an hour.

reconfigure.title: Period sensor
reconfigure.description: A number calculated from the statistics recorded for **{entity}**: how long it spent in a state, what share of the period that was, or how often it changed.

data_description.states: Pick one or more states to combine, or type in a custom state. Leave empty to count changes between every state.
data_description.metric: Time is in hours. Share is the time as a percentage of the period so far.
data_description.period: Periods start at midnight, on Monday, on the first of the month or the first of January, in this Home Assistant's time zone.
data_description.name: Leave blank for a name made from the entity, the states and the period.
data_description.live: Statistics are compiled hourly. With this on, the sensor follows the entity's changes since the last compiled hour as they happen; with it off, it updates once an hour.

error.state_ignored: That state is not recorded under this entry's settings, so a sensor over it would never move. Change the entry's states first, or pick a recorded one.
error.state_unusable: A state name needs letters or digits.
error.all_states_count_only: With no states picked, only the number of changes can be measured. Add a state above, or select number of changes below.

options.record: Record every state, including unavailable and unknown
options.record_known: Record known states, ignoring unavailable and unknown
options.ignore_short_unknown: Record known states, and unavailable and unknown only when they last a minimum duration
options.ignore_short: Record every state only when it lasts a minimum duration, including unavailable and unknown

options.ignore: Ignore - carry the previous state forward

options.duration: Time in the states, in hours
options.share: Share of the period in the states, as a percentage
options.count: Number of changes into the states

options.ignore_short: Record only when it lasts the minimum duration
options.ignore: Ignore - carry the previous state forward

yaml_clash.title: Duplicate configuration for {entity_id}
yaml_clash.description: {entity_id} is configured both in configuration.yaml and as a helper. The YAML configuration is being used and the helper has been disabled, because two configurations write conflicting values to the same statistics. Remove one of them.
